_status: Parameters for generate_synthetic_trials.py. Each entry has a source or is marked PLACEHOLDER. Placeholders set absolute levels only; DD-vs-typical differences come from the evidence-based z-scores in synthetic_children_v1 (register G1-G4). Replace placeholders with pilot estimates.

n_children.source: Subset of synthetic_children_v1 at 5% prevalence (G3); >= Riley 2020 minimum of 1,425 (G7)

sessions_per_child.source: Pilot design: about 2 sessions per child ([P-C3] pp. 18-19, team_interface I6)

grades.source: Target population ages 6-8 = Grades 1-3; equal thirds is a simulation design choice

age_months_by_grade.source: PLACEHOLDER: one year per grade starting at 6 y; replace when the school-entry rule (C1) is sourced

activity_selection.source: Uniform over activities taught at the grade (NIE, nie_curriculum_map.md Section 0); stands in for C2's adaptive XGBoost selection, like C2's fixed-curriculum baseline ([P-C2] p. 25)

comparison_symbolic_share.source: Grade 1: symbolic comparison not taught (C3b); grades 2-3 share is a PLACEHOLDER until C2 confirms representation

counting_subitizing_share.source: PLACEHOLDER share of counting items with 1-3 objects; counting to 20 is Grade 1 content ([NIE-G1] 2.1-2.2), so counting 4+ occurs at every grade

logit_per_z.source: PLACEHOLDER: converts the child's accuracy z-score to a per-question logit shift

rt_censor_s.source: Robot demo after > 15 s hesitation ([P-C1] p. 29, I3)

wrong_answer_offsets.source: Off-by-one errors named as the main error type ([P-C1] pp. 32, 36-37); weights PLACEHOLDER

behaviour_probs.source: PLACEHOLDER; independent of DD because no effect size is available (G8 principle)
